lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A grid-like arrangement of high-luminance circular spots is visible posterior to the gill slits. The spots are organized into roughly horizontal rows with increased inter-blob spacing compared to the densely packed cephalic region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of slightly elevated pixel intensity are visible, intersecting the horizontal rows of white blobs to form a characteristic checkerboard pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal ridge is visible along the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a high-intensity highlight on its dorsal edge and a corresponding shadow on its ventral edge, extending from the gill region toward the posterior.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin silhouette contains multiple high-luminance blobs of varying sizes, distributed across the visible lateral surface with moderate density.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A large, irregularly shaped area of depigmentation or reddish-hued tissue is visible on the posterior flank near the caudal peduncle. A small, distinct red focal point is also visible near the ventral margin of the posterior gill slits.
other_distinctive_markers: A small, high-intensity white localized cluster, possibly an ectoparasite or biological attachment, is visible on the dorsal ridge anterior to the first dorsal fin.
